fields.description: Issue includes an editorial on Florida Power & Light and proposals for municipal acquisition; an investigative report alleging deceptive sales practices at the Browning King clothing store; coverage linking Miami's "Torture Doctor" T. Earl Moore to the death of painter D. Kuhl and discussion of other alleged patient harms; commentary on Republican public-relations strategy; reporting on legal and political efforts affecting pari-mutuel racing and proposed summer dog tracks in Dade County; a court case over nuisance conditions from a poultry/slaughter and quick-freeze plant in Opa-locka; local columns and civic notes including airport/port authority statistics, education news, and entertainment/nightlife listings and advertisements.
